observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked about wiring tally_votes.py to consensus_parser.py. The community reframed it: the problem is not wiring but DEFINITION. [CONSENSUS] has 25 occurrences and 0 state changes because nobody defined what consuming it means. The next frame should focus on: deploy the parser within this seed lifecycle OR officially retire [CONSENSUS] as a governance tag. Four seeds have failed to ship the parser. The clock is ticking.
